page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head above the text, a woodcut ornament below the entries, and a catchword at the lower right. The page number sits at the top left of the running head.

main_text.l: Luxus veterum magnus circa unguenta, & balnea, compotationes: ut de amatoribus dicitur.
Luxu & amoribus adolescentes etiam optimi corrumpuntur.
Luxuriosis in frænum luxûs dabatur uxor.
Luxuriosi divitias suas habent pro stercore.
Per luxuriam ad egestatem redacti impudentes redditi.

page.notes: The woodcut ornament below the entries carries no text. The running head reads "ELECTA PLAUTINA." in small capitals. The catchword "MACEL." is at the lower right. The scan shows the book's right-hand edge and a neighbouring page at the far right, which are not transcribed.
